fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Three functions in `decksite/data/rule.py` (`mistagged_decks`, `doubled_decks`, `overlooked_decks`) each duplicated the same pattern of building a comma-separated id string and calling `deck.load_decks(where=f'd.id IN ({ids_list})')`, with no shared abstraction.

## What changed

- Added `load_decks_by_ids(ids: list[int]) -> list[Deck]` to `decksite/data/deck.py` (lines 33–38). It guards on an empty list (returning `[]`) and delegates to `load_decks` with an `IN` clause.
- Replaced the three manual id-list constructions in `decksite/data/rule.py` with calls to the new helper, removing 10 lines and simplifying each call site.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks).
- `uv run --frozen python dev.py unit` — 848 passed, 1 skipped (no failures or regressions).

Fixes #5756
